projects.name: Crypto Analytical Tool

description.en: A Python-based cryptocurrency analysis tool that retrieves market data, calculates technical indicators, analyzes market trends and potential breakout scenarios, and stores analysis results in CSV files.
description.fa: یک ابزار تحلیل بازار ارزهای دیجیتال با Python که داده‌های بازار را دریافت می‌کند، شاخص‌های تکنیکال را محاسبه می‌کند، وضعیت روند و سناریوهای احتمالی شکست سطوح را بررسی می‌کند و نتایج تحلیل را در فایل CSV ذخیره می‌کند.

verified_features: Market data retrieval using CoinMarketCap API
Historical candlestick data retrieval using KuCoin API

contribution.description: The project was developed collaboratively. Exact individual contributions should not be claimed unless separately confirmed.

limitations: The tool provides analytical information, not guaranteed trading signals.
Its output should not be presented as financial advice.

description.en: A console-based Python application that combines basic banking operations with hotel reservation management. It includes account creation, transactions, room management, booking, cancellation, and an integrated internal payment process.
